intro: Prospector Stormpike has decrypted the letter you found among thieves in the Alterac foothills, but cannot make sense of it. He tells you to take it to the magistrate of Southshore.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I decrypted the letter, but I don't know what to make of it. You found this among thieves in the Alterac foothills? Very strange...
You should take this to the magistrate of Southshore. Although this letter is cryptic, his is the closest town to Alterac; if a threat is brewing, then he should know.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Friend. Have you been traveling through the foothills and mountains again? What news do you bring?

clips.title: Completion
paras: This is translated from a letter you found in a Syndicate encampment? This was not written by a thief, or even a noble of Alterac.
It appears The Syndicate has ties to another power, and I shudder to think what that might be.
